info.name: Modular Monolith DDD VSA API
info.description:
## Modular Monolith + DDD + Vertical Slices Boilerplate

Full API suite: 74 requests. Bearer JWT auth.

### Auth Flow (run in order):
1. `Captcha > Get Client Key`: get captcha key (auto-saves)
2. `OTP > Send OTP`: send SMS with captcha
3. `Auth > Create Tokens`: verify OTP, get JWT tokens (auto-saves)
4. All other endpoints use auto-injected `{{accessToken}}`

Requests that need an administrator scope (store approval, stock level changes, warehouse connections, product export) need a token of a user in the `system-admin` role. Requests that upload a file have an empty `File` field to fill in.

### Postman Features Used:
- **Collection variables**: auto-saved between requests
- **Pre-request scripts**: auto-inject Bearer token
- **Test scripts**: status, response time, schema checks
- **Example responses**: structured success/error samples
- **Bearer auth**: configured at collection level with `{{accessToken}}`

exec: // A fresh delivery id per send. It is stored first so the signed body and the sent body are the same text.
// Sign the exact body that will be sent (variables resolved) with the connection's webhook secret.
console.warn("warehouseConnectionId or warehouseWebhookSecret not set. Run Create Warehouse Connection first.");

request.description: Anonymous callback from a store's warehouse system. Authenticated by an HMAC-SHA256 signature of the raw body in the X-Warehouse-Signature header, made with the webhook secret of the connection in the route (warehouseWebhookSecret, returned once by Create Warehouse Connection). The pre-request script signs the body. A deliveryId seen before on the connection is acknowledged and applies nothing. status is optional (held, confirmed, released or expired; a body without it is the original confirmation) and providerReference is required only when the status confirms the reservation. A status word this system has no mapping for is acknowledged and recorded, and the reservation turns read-only. 204 No Content.
